about_the_game:
HoloSeeker is a deckbuilding roguelite RPG where you advance through an adventure map.

With different events and encounters waiting every run, you can enjoy a brand-new adventure each time you play!

Features

Four idols to lead your adventure!

Choose from four hololive members, each with unique abilities that completely change how you build your deck:

  • Usada Pekora – Stock up on Carrots by drawing cards to gain the upper hand in battle.

  • Nekomata Okayu – Low defense, but high evasion lets her slip past danger.

  • Takanashi Kiara – With the power of Phoenix Feathers, she can revive even after her HP drops to zero.

  • Fuwamoco – Build up Mischief Stock by dealing damage to unleash powerful, high-cost cards effectively.

Over 100 cards to discover!

Cute illustrations, unique effects, and countless combinations may turn the tide of your journey.

Earn HoloCoins during your adventure and purchase your favorite cards from the shop to strengthen your deck!
